Daily predawn and midday tree water deficit extrema (local time)

Source: R/phase.R
dm_pdmd_extrema.Rd

Extracts, per series and local-time day, the predawn minimum and midday maximum of the tree water deficit from hourly L2 data, using fixed local-time hour windows. compute_pdmd_extrema_tz() is the original DendroMatic name, kept as an exported alias.

Usage

compute_pdmd_extrema_tz(
  L2_hourly,
  pd_start_hr,
  pd_end_hr,
  md_start_hr,
  md_end_hr,
  tz
)

dm_pdmd_extrema(L2_hourly, pd_start_hr, pd_end_hr, md_start_hr, md_end_hr, tz)

Arguments

L2_hourly

Hourly L2 data.frame with columns series, ts, twd.

pd_start_hr, pd_end_hr

Predawn window (local hours, inclusive).

md_start_hr, md_end_hr

Midday window (local hours, inclusive).

tz

Local timezone used to derive day and hour.

Value

A data.frame with one row per series and local date, holding pdtwd (window minimum) and mdtwd (window maximum).
